grading: case-insensitive substring. truth = list of groups; every group must match (any one alternative in a group). wrong = any term present marks a wrong-term hit. NOT_IN_PAGES = graded by hand. page = the page id(s) in library/INDEX-ep12.json that hold the answer; a list = the answer needs every page in it. hid-dst-2025: the right answer is 'no problems' (Daniel checked 212 bookings); a code miss there is hand-checked. The mix of kinds is designed, not sampled.
